title: Sections with support of a constructible complex are constructible
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, an algebraic closure
$\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in it.
Assume that $X,Z,U$ are separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and all
morphisms are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let
$\Lambda=\underline E$ or $\underline{\Qlb}$, with the condensed coefficient rings of
[sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], pulled back to each scheme
as in [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Write $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$
for the unbounded derived category of $\Lambda_T$-module objects and
$\Dbc(T,\Lambda)$ for its full subcategory of bounded complexes with constructible
cohomology [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible].

Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion with open complement
$j:U\hookrightarrow X$. Use the module-object derived functors of
[sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], writing $i^*,j^*$ for the exact derived
inverse images and $i_*$ for the exact closed direct image. Let
$R\underline\Gamma_Z$ be the right derived functor of
$M\mapsto i^*\ker(M\to j_*j^*M)$, as in [sk-lem-formal-closed-support].
For $K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ the sequence
$$
i_*R\underline\Gamma_ZK\longrightarrow K\longrightarrow Rj_*j^*K
\longrightarrow (i_*R\underline\Gamma_ZK)[1]
$$
whose first two arrows are the counit of $i_*\dashv R\underline\Gamma_Z$
and the unit of $j^*\dashv Rj_*$ is a distinguished triangle in
$D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$. All its terms, including the shifted term,
lie in $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$, and $R\underline\Gamma_ZK\in\Dbc(Z,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Finite type over the Noetherian field gives IsLocallyNoetherian X, and the quasi-compact structure map makes X compact. Thus X is Noetherian and quasi-separated, and the open immersion j is quasi-compact. Rewrite ringChar k=p and expose the already given finite-type, quasi-compact and separated structure-map instances on the corresponding Over objects.

For any coefficient and scheme morphism f, formalSupportPullback is exact. Its termwise derived functor preserves boundedness and commutes with cohomology. Whisker Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv by sheaf inverse image to compare its cohomology objects with ordinary coefficient-compatible upperStar. Apply the existing constructible-module pullback theorem and transport constructibility across this comparison. This proves supportPullback_constructible for both i and j without any finiteness assumption.

Apply the existing formal_closed_support_adjunction realization of det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction, at derived Hom universe u+1. Its output supplies an ordinary adjunction a with kernel-normalized counit, a derived adjunction b equal to a.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction, the open adjunction c equal to formalSupportPullbackAdjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction, a distinguished localization triangle, and the fiber comparison. Substitute the two equalities. The first arrow is already the actual counit, so no second counit normalization argument is required. In ClosedSupportConstructibleAssertions, derive finite-colimit preservation locally from a.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits before forming the termwise derived closed direct image, instead of quantifying a redundant independent preservation witness. The quantified adjunction already implies this property.

For each finite intermediate field E, or the finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient, install its IsFinitenessCoefficient witness. Apply boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_obj along the given k-morphism j to the constructible formal pullback j* K from step 2. This proves bounded constructibility of B=Rj*j*K in the existing internal-module convention.

Use the finite-field or algebraic-closure condensed constructible Serre theorem on the Noetherian space X to obtain kernel, cokernel and extension closure. Transport chosen kernels and cokernels across their unique comparison isomorphisms to install the ObjectProperty closure instances. The generic conditional isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_of_serre theorem then supplies triangulatedness for the actual boundedConstructible predicate used here. This avoids the different finite-constant-model predicate in det-cor-coefficient-heart-ii-triangulated.

For F=i* RGamma_Z K, the distinguished triangle has second vertex K and third vertex B. Apply ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed1 to their constructibility to obtain bounded constructibility of F; shift stability gives F[1]. The fiber comparison gives RGamma_Z K isomorphic to formal i* F. Step 2 gives constructibility of this pullback, and isomorphism closure transports it back to RGamma_Z K. Return the original normalized ordinary adjunction, its normalization proof, and these four constructibility proofs together with the same distinguished triangle. Repeat for the two coefficient choices.

proof_origin.place: Both paragraphs; A7 formalizes the normalized localization triangle, exact pullback, open direct-image finiteness, coefficient-specific Serre triangulatedness, and closed-pullback fiber comparison. Q9 reapplies the returned repair to the current restored module: derive finite-colimit preservation inside the assertion from its quantified adjunction, keeping all existing imports and completed proofs.

lean.statement: theorem closedSupport_constructible (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ) {Z U X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))] [U.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [i.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ) : (∀ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ, ClosedSupportConstructibleAssertions (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E) i j) ∧ ClosedSupportConstructibleAssertions (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj.{u} ℓ) i j
lean.note: The conjunction covers every finite intermediate field and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient, each with its canonical ring-object structure. ClosedSupportConstructibleAssertions expands the node assertion using the existing formalClosedSupport functor and its kernel-normalized ordinary adjunction, derived by the existing exact-left/right-derived adjunction construction. No support functor or constructibility predicate is copied. The normalized adjunction is existential in the conclusion rather than assumed or selected from an arbitrary Nonempty object.
